details: For every finite binary class, the largest projected minimum 1-inclusion degree is at most its effective range.
proof: Each coordinate projection has effective range at most \mathrm E(\mathcal H), and every vertex in its 1-inclusion graph has at most one neighbor per effective coordinate. Its minimum degree is therefore at most \mathrm E(\mathcal H). Maximize over projections.
name: Effective Range / Projected Minimum Degree
